scope: Supplied CAD to scene instance classification; no robot execution or trained motor policy.

capture.placement: CAD-only supported static poses, no dynamic settling; no ground-truth-based scene acceptance.
capture.gripper_exclusion: Robot and gripper geometry omitted in all newly rendered scenes, identically for every method.

depth_stress.generation: Noise applied to full observed depth, no object masks. Missing pixels occur in spatial blocks, including boundaries. Re-run localization for primary pipeline.

CLIP: Unchanged four-term image/text mean and maximum over existing20CADviews. Frozen pretrained CLIP and two original Qwen keywords/phrases prompts from prior CLIP study.
Qwen: Local qwen3.5:9b only, exact previous generation controls; preserve raw outputs and no content/length retries.
localization: Previous voxel2mm/plane2mm/DBSCAN20mm/min50 cluster parameters, no forced object count, no simulator extrinsics/poses/masks.
fit: Frozen zero-contact native-scale CAD support-face/36yaw initialization and x/y/yaw ICP, same full-union/depth score. No penetration rejection or external-occluder carving.
availability: Rank available candidate scores; preserve each unavailable candidate. No usable candidates or exact highest-score tie within1e-12 gives unavailable/ambiguous. An unavailable distractor does not veto valid competitors.
size_control: Minimum-area table-plane footprint long/short dimensions and maximum observed table-relative height, compare bestCADsupport. Score=1-mean(min(abs(dimension difference)/0.005m,1)); no fitted scale.
absence_duplicates: Primary ranker and separately declared development-calibrated plausibility diagnostic; no held-out threshold tuning. Correct class localization and singular-request ambiguity reported separately.
real_data: 20 cached real T-LESS frames, deterministic first available RGB-D frame per scene, all30CADs onboarding; exact selection and conversion frozen separately before inference. Not full BOP benchmark.
new_query_CADs: Four female connector CADs not previously queried in searched JSON; previously present asfixtures, not globally unseen assets. Dedicated cohort frozen before inference.
evaluation: Freeze predictions before reading audit labels. Identity/boxIoU>=0.5 primary; maskIoU,proposalrecall,CLIPrecall@5,wrongsize/wrongfamily,unavailable,rejection and ambiguity separately. Paired effects and scene-cluster bootstrap intervals.
training: No weight updates, paid APIs, GPT calls, global environment edits, physical robot/camera operation.
resource_policy: GPU sequential model ownership, CPU geometry16workers when memory safe. Reuse exact observation/CAD computations across paired RGB-only conditions; execution optimizations require reference parity checks.
